trial_title: HD5 Levels in Catheter Versus Bag Urine Specimens in Young Children for the Diagnosis of UTI
brief_summary: Urinary tract infections (UTIs) are a common cause of bacteremia and serious bacterial infections in young children (2-24 months of age). Because these children are usually unable to say what symptoms they are experiencing, UTIs are diagnosed through testing. Current testing of urine samples require a catheter or suprapubic aspiration performed for urine collection for infections markers to be reliable. Bag specimens often have varying results that can be poor in sensitivity and specificity depe

eligibility_table.criterion: Patient is between 1 to 24 months of age
Patient has reported or measured fever >38.5 degrees C (101.3 degrees F)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of altered mental status and urosepsis, but there is no specific mention of a current fever >38.5 degrees C.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient reported or been measured to have a fever of ≥38.5 degrees C (101.3 degrees F)?

eligibility_table.criterion: RSV Positive at time of urine collection
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding RSV status at the time of urine collection.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently RSV positive as determined by a PCR test or rapid antigen test at the time of urine collection?

eligibility_table.criterion: Flu Positive at time of urine collection
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided regarding Flu status at the time of urine collection.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's urine specimen positive for flu at the time of collection, as determined by a PCR test with a threshold of ≥10 copies/mL?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of neurogenic bladder, which is considered a known GU abnormality.
The patient has a documented neurogenic bladder condition.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone catheterization ≥3 times in the past month?
